description: A Flutter widget representing a checkout screen in a shopping app. It includes UI components such as a top bar, address and payment method sections, order summary, and a place order button. The file defines the `CheckoutScreen` class and several internal widgets for layout components.

classes.name: CheckoutScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the checkout page with UI layout and components.

classes.name: _SectionCard
classes.description: A reusable widget for address and payment method sections with tap behavior.

classes.name: _SummaryRow
classes.description: A widget displaying a row of order summary data such as subtotal, delivery, total.

classes.name: _Badge
classes.description: A small circular badge widget used for cart item count.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the `CheckoutScreen`, including layout and interactions.
